title: Running average
description:
A sensor produces one reading at a time. Write `double runningAverage(double reading)` that returns the average of **every reading it has been given so far**.

```cpp
runningAverage(10.0)   // 10   (just the one)
runningAverage(20.0)   // 15   (10 and 20)
runningAverage(30.0)   // 20   (10, 20 and 30)
```

The function needs to remember two things between calls. Use `static` local variables: this is exactly what they are for.
hints: Remember the sum of all readings and how many there have been. The average is one divided by the other.
